question: I need to ask you something, Oda-sensei. I want to give you a letter directly, but I don't know where to send it. Please tell me your address.
answer: Ahh. An address. For a letter. ... BUT I GOT YOUR LETTER. (DUN-DUN-DUUNNN!) Umm. There are two adresses you can use. You can use the address for the editors' offices as written in Jump Magazine, or the special mailbox for the SBS questions only. Either way, it all comes right to me so don't worry.
